<!-- pr-reviewer: c0a58d36be1e4bf3d868529e0cb6c2fc559dc781 -->
Code review clean. The PR conflicts with main and cannot merge yet.

The Zigzag rows and closing passes have independent coverage tests. Parameter validation, undo, project storage, and MCP use the existing command path. Adaptive remains refused. The path states its previous-tool trust assumption.

Local verification:

The trial merge with upstream/main at `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425` failed in `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs`. I aborted the merge. The results below apply to the PR head, not a combined tree. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Motion unit tests | 366 passed; 5 ignored |
| Motion machining2d | 66 passed |
| Motion pocket_refusal | 3 passed |
| Motion rest2d | 10 passed |
| Motion rest_zigzag | 2 passed |
| Motion predrilled_entry | 6 passed |
| App unit tests, golden_cl, predrilled_entry | Passed |
| App project_roundtrip | 73 passed |
| App rest_pocket | 6 passed |
| App tool_gate | 9 passed |
| UI unit tests, from crates/ui | 813 passed; 6 ignored |
| Clippy: motion, app, UI; all targets; -D warnings | Passed |

The quick-gate dry run selected most app suites. This review ran the targeted suites above, not the full workspace gate.

Safety review: I ran two mutations locally.

- Remove the closing rings: the coverage test failed with 287 missed points instead of 0. Restore the source: both Zigzag tests passed.
- Replace the capped inset with a fixed 0.01 mm inset: the tiny-pocket test failed with `the closing ring alone leaves the pocket center uncut`. Restore the source: both Zigzag tests passed.

The source was restored byte for byte. The worktree had no tracked changes after verification.

I read all 128 lines of the new `pocket_rest_corners.cl` golden. It has four corner passes at three heights. Lateral rapids remain at or above the stock top. No existing golden changes in the PR diff.

Requested before merge: resolve the conflict in `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs` when this stack reaches its merge turn. Merge parent #1817 first, as the PR body states. Verify the combined tree after the refresh.

Notes: `mill2d_page.rs` only preserves the rest field. The other UI edits update test fixtures. No visible control changes, so before/after UI images do not apply. The dialog is tracked separately in #1815. The body includes `Process change: yes`. No dependency, build script, or workflow changes require a maintainer-only build decision.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The review fix is complete locally. I did not push it because the combined tree does not compile.

The conflict came from main moving the links tests to `crates/app/tests/level_links/choices.rs`. I kept that move and added `rest: None` to the moved fixture. I extended `choices::links_round_trip_and_the_defaults_write_no_key`. Removing the field failed with E0063. Restoring it passed all 25 level-links tests, including the bore-floor checks.

The gate found another main-added fixture that needs `rest: None` in `first_router_part.rs`. That missing field failed compilation. The restored router suite passed all four tests. The rest-pocket suite passed six tests. The rest-Zigzag suite passed two tests.

Verification is blocked by E0004 at `crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:43`. The match omits `MachineKind::Waterjet`. Both that file and `crates/post/src/machine/kind.rs` match upstream/main at `57f2ffbbf51a32e9f71be6d4d0014184b1713f41`. This error is outside the review findings.

The quick gate passed its motion step. Its app step found the router fixture error. Its UI step found E0004. The run was VOID because the router fix changed the tree during the run. Clippy for motion, app, and UI also failed with E0004.

Local fixes remain on branch `fix-2037` at `d7652f8ed302b70eafd504fc9e8de9e30f3b1ce2`. The PR head remains `c0a58d36be1e4bf3d868529e0cb6c2fc559dc781`. Parent #1817 remains open. Please re-review after the main compile error is fixed and the final gate passes.

Merged upstream/main at a49322b9 to resolve the level-links conflict. I kept main’s test move and bore-floor checks. The moved Pocket fixture retains `rest: None`. The extended `choices::links_round_trip_and_the_defaults_write_no_key` pins non-rest loading for default and picked links. Removing the field failed with E0063. Giving the fixture rest parameters failed the new assertion. Restoring it passed all 25 level-links tests.

Main’s new router fixture also needs `rest: None`. Removing it failed with E0063. Restoring it passed all four `first_router_part` tests. The rest-pocket suite passed six tests. Rest-Zigzag passed two tests.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. Motion and app passed. UI reported 913 passed, one failed, and six ignored. The sole failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`, because no graphics adapter was available. That test is unchanged from main. All UI integration suites passed. Clippy for motion, app, and UI passed with all targets and warnings denied.

New head: 9c4d73221aa0c7ed2665ab309b8ab49011abb8b8. I returned the PR to draft before pushing. Parent #1817 is still open and must merge first.

Please re-review the conflict resolution and pins. The graphics test still needs a run on a host with an adapter.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9c4d73221aa0c7ed2665ab309b8ab49011abb8b8 -->
Needs changes before merge: add the required UI images to the PR body.

I reviewed the current head against the laws in upstream/main at `dab6498aed0ab078a97f0892c417d161135219fa`. The local trial merge with that main completed without conflicts. No GitHub runner was used. No commit or push was made.

The earlier conflict finding is resolved. The moved level-links fixture keeps `rest: None`. The new assertions check that default and selected links keep a non-rest pocket after loading. The router fixture also keeps `rest: None`. The bore-floor checks remain in place. All 25 level-links tests and all four router tests passed in the combined tree.

The rest parameters use the existing command, undo, project-file and MCP paths. The Zigzag tests check coverage, gouges and rapids. The path records the trust placed in the entered previous tool.

Local build and test results for the combined tree:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Motion unit tests | 395 passed; 6 ignored |
| Motion machining2d | 66 passed |
| Motion pocket_refusal | 3 passed |
| Motion predrilled_entry | 6 passed |
| Motion rest2d | 10 passed |
| Motion rest_zigzag | 2 passed |
| App unit tests | 350 passed; 1 ignored |
| App first_router_part | 4 passed |
| App golden_cl | 33 passed |
| App level_links | 25 passed |
| App predrilled_entry | 8 passed |
| App project_roundtrip | 73 passed |
| App rest_pocket | 6 passed |
| App tool_gate | 9 passed |
| UI unit tests, from crates/ui | 913 passed; 1 failed; 6 ignored |
| UI edge_loop_pick, from crates/ui | 3 passed |
| Clippy: motion, app and UI; all targets; warnings denied | Passed |

The UI failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1902`:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

The full error reports no suitable software or hardware adapter. That test file is unchanged from upstream/main. This result does not prove a defect in this PR. It also does not give a passing graphics result. Run that test on a host with a graphics adapter before merge.

The quick-gate dry run selected a broad set of suites. I ran the selected suites listed above, not the full quick gate or the full workspace tests.

This is a safety-tier review. I ran these two mutations myself in the local review worktree:

- Remove the closing passes: RED. The corner-coverage test found 287 missed points. Restore the file: GREEN, both Zigzag tests passed.
- Use a fixed 0.01 mm inset: RED. The tiny-pocket test reported that the closing ring left the pocket center uncut. Restore the file: GREEN, both Zigzag tests passed.

The source file was restored byte for byte after each mutation. The final working tree had no unstaged tracked changes beyond the staged trial merge.

I read all 128 lines of `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_rest_corners.cl`. It adds four corner passes at three heights. Lateral rapids stay at or above the stock top. The PR changes no existing CL or NC golden file. The app golden and rest-pocket tests passed.

Required change:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs:241`: the PR changes UI source, but its body has no before/after screenshots. Add both images and link them from the PR body. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit images to this PR branch. This review's explicit UI-image rule applies to this change. The earlier review did not require these images.

The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` or change a dependency, build script, workflow or script. Keep the stated merge order: parent #1817 first.

GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`. The review label is `needs-rework` for the missing images. The PR stays in draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: none. The latest review's missing before/after UI images remain blocked by this host's graphics environment.

I built a temporary Pocket Passes capture harness against the exact merge base, a49322b9. Rendering failed with `CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")`. The OpenGL fallback failed the same way. No PNG was produced. I restored the temporary harness and removed its worktree. The body-image check remains RED because the images are missing. There is no completed fix to mutation-check.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. Motion and app passed. UI had 913 passed, one failed, and six ignored. The sole failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`, with no graphics adapter. All selected UI integration suites passed. The run was valid, not VOID.

Clippy for motion, app, and UI, with all targets and warnings denied: GREEN.

Head unchanged: 9c4d73221aa0c7ed2665ab309b8ab49011abb8b8. No commit or push was made. No images or review evidence were added to the PR branch. The PR body, draft state, and labels are unchanged.

Please re-review after both images are captured on a host with a graphics adapter, published only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and linked from the PR body. The graphics test also needs a passing run on that host.

Added the required before/after Pocket Passes images to the PR body. Both images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, at `751e70d41`. The captures use `a49322b9` before and the reviewed head `9c4d732` after. They are identical because the change preserves the rest field without changing visible controls.

The body-image check was RED on the original body. Removing either image link was RED. Restoring both was GREEN. Both published images downloaded with matching hashes.

Merged `upstream/main` at `4b7a6b1e8`. The two conflicts only changed line wrapping around `rest: None`. Both fields and the existing assertions remain. All 25 level-links tests, including the bore-floor checks, all four router tests, and all six rest-pocket tests passed.

Quick gate: GREEN (3 steps, no failures; valid run). Clippy for motion, app, and UI passed with all targets and warnings denied. `headless_run_succeeds` passed with the lavapipe adapter selected through `VK_DRIVER_FILES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.json`.

New head: `2af8b6bcbf1d4d80f10de50f4a363dc39213afaf`.

Please re-review the screenshot fix and conflict resolution.

Code review clean. The PR conflicts with current main and cannot merge yet.

I used the laws in `upstream/main` at `e3ca44fa705d71438a8fd8a8efccbafcc2b6517f`. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

The earlier image finding is resolved. The PR body links both Pocket Passes images from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. Both links downloaded. I inspected both images. Their hashes match, as the body explains: the field preservation does not change the visible controls.

The earlier fixture fixes remain intact. The level-links test checks that default and selected links preserve a non-rest Pocket after loading. The router fixture keeps `rest: None`. Parent PR #1817 has merged.

The Zigzag change uses the existing parameter, command, undo, project-file and MCP paths. Adaptive remains refused. The path states its trust in the entered previous tool. The decision file records the inset and closing-pass choices. The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION` or add dependencies.

Trial merge result:

The merge with current main failed in these files:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs:72`: this PR adds `pocket_zigzag`; main adds `pocket_emit`.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:272`: this PR adds rest passes where main moves pocket emission into `pocket_emit.rs`.

I aborted the merge. The results below apply to the PR head, not a combined tree. Resolve these conflicts when this PR reaches its merge turn. Preserve both modules and the rest-pass selection. Test the combined tree after the refresh.

Local results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|

| Motion machining2d | 66 passed |

| UI headless_run_succeeds, exact rerun | 1 passed with lavapipe |

The UI failure is `egui_app::tests::stock_fit::stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_fit.rs:31`:

```text
Found two or more nodes matching the query:
By {
    label: "Delete",
}
```

The exact rerun also failed. The full UI tree matches the merged main baseline `4b7a6b1e8`. This PR changes no UI file against that baseline. Current main fixes the lookup in `a3774b8c0`. This is an inherited failure, not a new finding against this change. The graphics test passed with `VK_DRIVER_FILES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.json`.

The quick-gate dry run selected broad motion and app suites. I ran the targeted suites above, not the full quick gate.

This is a safety-tier review. I ran these mutations myself:

- Remove the closing rings: RED. The coverage test found 287 missed points. Restore the file: GREEN, both Zigzag tests passed.
- Replace the capped inset with a fixed 0.01 mm inset: RED. The tiny-pocket test found an uncut center. Restore the file: GREEN, both Zigzag tests passed.

The source was restored byte for byte after each mutation. No tracked changes remain.

The current PR diff changes no CL, NC or snapshot golden. I also read all 128 lines of the inherited `pocket_rest_corners.cl` golden. Its four corner passes repeat at three heights. Lateral rapids remain above the stock top. The golden and rest-pocket tests passed.

No new code changes are requested. GitHub reports `CONFLICTING`, so this review uses `conflicts`, not `merge-ready`. The earlier `needs-rework` image finding is resolved on this new head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review's conflict finding remains unresolved. I attempted a merge of upstream/main at a14fa0c8d into the reviewed head 2af8b6bcb in an isolated worktree, then aborted it under the resolve-conflicts skill's same-logic stop rule. No commit or push was made.

Conflicts:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`: the PR adds `pocket_zigzag`; main adds `pocket_emit`. Both modules are required.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs`, `pocket_over`, immediately after pass planning: the PR replaces Zigzag passes with `rest_passes` when `hold_crossings` is true, then emits inline. Main replaces that inline emission with `emit_pocket_passes(PocketWalks { ... })` and moves the emission logic into `pocket_emit.rs`. Main's emitter also uses the current entry-top and link-certification behavior. Choosing either conflict side wholesale would lose the rest selection or main's emission changes.

The skill explicitly requires aborting when a refactor and a change overlap the same logic. This needs a maintainer-directed resolution preserving both modules, applying the rest-pass selection before the shared emitter, and retaining main's emission safety checks. The combined tree has not been tested because no resolution was made. The PR head, body, labels, and ready state remain unchanged.

Resolved the latest review's compatible merge conflicts locally. Both pocket_zigzag and pocket_emit remain. Zigzag rest passes are selected before shared emission on both rest paths. Main's emitter and its safety checks are unchanged.

Extended zigzag_rest_covers_corner_residue_without_gouges_or_unsafe_rapids to require interior Zigzag rows. Ring-only selection made it RED. Restoring selection made it GREEN. Extended tiny_rest_pocket_keeps_interior_rows_when_previous_tool_fits_nowhere to require the non-center-cutting entry refusal. Removing the emitter refusal made it RED. Restoring it made it GREEN.

Quick gate: GREEN. All 109 steps passed in a valid run. Motion clippy with all targets and warnings denied: GREEN. App clippy: RED. Unchanged upstream/main fixture crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs has E0308 at line 107 (WorkMaterial instead of Option<WorkMaterial>) and E0063 at line 106 (missing stepdown and stepover). I did not change that unrelated fixture.

Held local commit: b27865f6ca4ae4ceeed9bc1afc05983cc97bfdbd on fix-2037-review. No push was made because required app clippy is blocked. PR head remains 2af8b6bcbf1d4d80f10de50f4a363dc39213afaf. I returned the PR to draft before the planned push. Labels and images are unchanged.

Please re-review the conflict fix after the inherited fixture is corrected and the held commit is pushed.
